text: {"answer": "The on-disk KB store (.tree-fs.json + .knowledge-base.yml) is owned by the Nuxt/Backend layer, which performs the writes, while the kb-mcp server only reads those files directly. The browser reaches FastAPI only indirectly: it issues fetches to the Nuxt 3 Web UI (dev port 6789 / prod 3000), which acts as a server-to-server proxy (trust_env=False) and forwards requests to the FastAPI backend (dev 8765 / prod 8001) — the browser never hits FastAPI directly.", "evidence_used": ["ARCHITECTURE"]}
